lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Are you free now?
Yeah, what's up?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I've got a bit of a problem.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Can you help me figure something out?
Sure.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I want to get something for Belorta as a gift.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: But I don't know what to buy.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I asked her if she wanted something,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: but she didn't tell me anything :(

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: What should I get Belorta to make her happy?
A yummy cake.
A doll fashioned after you.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: A cake?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That sounds nice.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Belorta is a big fan of sweets, after all.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: All right, it's settled.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'll make a cake with Belorta's face on it.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: A doll made to look like me?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That sounds nice.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: But I don't think I'd be able to buy that anywhere.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'd have to make one myself.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: If it's a tiny one, like those for a keychain, I think I could pull that off.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'll show it to you as soon as I'm done with it.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Thanks for helping me out, Old-Timer!
No problem.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Say,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: would you like something as a gift as well?
No, that's okay.
I'd like anything that you give me.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: If you ever want something in the future, don't hesitate to tell me,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: and I'll make it happen.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Ha, really?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Looks like I'll have to add one more item to my list

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: when preparing the gift for Belorta.
Looking forward to what you get me.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: All right, I'm off to check out some gifts.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: See you around!
